description: Manage database credentials for runtime services.
autoMigrateNote: Value from Doppler. A runtime override may take precedence.
rotateBody: Creates a new MySQL user for {schema} and updates Doppler ({project}/{config}). {service} restarts. The old user stays until you revoke it.
setBody: Creates or updates the named MySQL user with data access to {schema}, then writes the credentials to Doppler. {service} restarts.
revokeBody: Deletes the MySQL user and its grants. Revoke only retired users. Deleting the active user interrupts {service}.
actionFailed: Could not complete the credential change.
genNote: Generate a value in this browser and copy it to your clipboard.
genCopyFailed: Could not copy. Check clipboard access.
